name: En-shar-ra ~Kare no Mono no Chi o Sasageyo~
original_name: アン・シャル・ラ ～彼の者の血を捧げよ～
source:
They have known human blood with lust, and have obtained eternal time, and therefore have become proud. Our doom is inevitable. Our sins cannot be atoned for, nor can they be forgiven. Then let us at least protect Mother Human ...... and her world. The 'Blood Covenant' that lives forever, he gives eternal life, I give crimson blood, from this blood, you can never, ever escape.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.ensharraforeign&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
他们因情欲了解了人类的血统，获得了永恒的时间，因此变得骄傲。我们的厄运是不可避免的。我们的罪孽无法弥补，也无法得到宽恕。那么至少让我们保护人类母亲……以及她的世界吧。永存的‘血之契约’，他赐予永生，我赐予猩红之血，从这血中，你永远、永远都无法逃脱。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.co.ciagram.otome.games.ensharraforeign&hl=en_US&gl=US]Google Play[/url]]
